==History==
Ellya and her mother, [[Careme Mowly]], were mentioned to [[Moiraine Damodred]] by the Lady [[Meri do Ahlan a'Conlin]] during the [[White Tower]]'s census in {{Ne|978}}.{{ref/book|0|5}}
